answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> The Holy Quran Question ID: 3759 Country: United Kingdom Title: Can you touch a Quran Tafseer without wudu? Question: Can you touch a Quran Tafseer without wudu? Answer ID: 3759 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 474/584=B) If the text of tafseer (Commentary of the Quran) is more in comparison to the words of Quran, then one can touch it even without wuzu . Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
